missing_feature_policy: keep_missing; never impute and never reduce every cell to an easier common subset
matrix_semantics: higher values are confidence-oriented after the frozen transform
score_semantics: every system output is converted once to higher_is_incorrect

global_fused_score_orientation.anchor: equal-family mean of the prepared confidence-oriented coordinates
global_fused_score_orientation.rule: when a method's fused confidence score has an unresolved global sign, multiply it by the sign of its Pearson correlation with the anchor; require absolute correlation above 1e-6
global_fused_score_orientation.scope: one whole-score sign only; this never changes any prepared feature coordinate
global_fused_score_orientation.final_conversion: negate the globally aligned confidence score once to obtain higher_is_incorrect risk

preprocessing_rules.ordinary_features: registered confidence sign, population z-score, final population z-score
preprocessing_rules.pe_mean: registered confidence sign, population z-score, negative square, final population z-score
preprocessing_rules.stft_spectral_entropy: registered confidence sign, population z-score, negative absolute distance between percentile rank and label-free KDE-mode percentile, final population z-score
preprocessing_rules.cusum_shift_idx: registered confidence sign, population z-score, unchanged, final population z-score
preprocessing_rules.rpdi: registered confidence sign, population z-score, unchanged, final population z-score

forbidden_operations: estimated sign(rho) as a headline arm
dropping rows or features based on labels
loading correctness labels during transformation or fitting
silently substituting a different feature contract
evidence_status: D0 retrospective development contract; runtime fitting is label-free but the transform choices were selected after outcomes on these cells were inspected
reconstruction_scope: matrix-level reconstruction from saved telemetry; not model re-generation and not a complete raw-feature rebuild
